purpose: Teach: 洗面/殺菌/バレンタインデー/ベーグル/教習所/ナポリ/競輪/大文字

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、洗面台の鏡を綺麗に拭きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's make sure we wipe down the bathroom mirror nice and clean.
lines.style: Soft, matter-of-fact instruction. Warm but practical — the tone of a parent guiding a routine task. Steady rhythm. Inclusive 'we' that brings him into the responsibility gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、給食前に殺菌ジェルで手を洗うよ
lines.en: Mom, I wash my hands with disinfectant gel before lunch.
lines.style: Quick, earnest delivery — he's offering information he finds important. No hesitation. Slight lift at the end, like he's sharing something he's proud of noticing. Small and genuine.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、バレンタインデーにお父さんへチョコ用意しましょう
lines.en: Sho, let's prepare some chocolate for Dad for Valentine's Day.
lines.style: Gentle invitation, inviting him to share in something soft and special. Slower pace than the last instruction. Warmth underneath — she's including him in caring for his father. Slight linger on the idea.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ベーグルにバター塗ってください
lines.en: Mom, can you spread butter on my bagel for me?
lines.style: Direct, simple request. No elaborate reasoning — just what he wants right now. Polite but uncomplicated. Quick beat. The straightforward ask of a child who trusts he'll be heard.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが新しい教習所に通われるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is attending a new driving school these days, apparently.
lines.style: Thoughtful observation shared conversationally. Slow, reflective — she's processing as she tells him. Quiet wonder in her tone. Not urgent, just... noteworthy. Slight trailing-off, like she's thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとナポリのピザ屋に行きたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to go to that Neapolitan pizza place with Dad.
lines.style: Hopeful, specific request. A small brightness in his voice — he has an idea and wants it to happen. No pressure underneath, just genuine wanting. Open ending, waiting for her response.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは絶対競輪には行かないと約束されてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father made a promise he'd never go to the keirin track.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring statement. She's offering him something solid — a promise kept is reliable. Quiet firmness. Not lecturing, just anchoring him in something true about his father. Clear breath at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと京都で大文字焼きを見たい
lines.en: Mom, I want to see the Daimonji bonfire in Kyoto with Dad.
lines.style: Wistful and specific. A memory he wants to make, not just any experience — this one, with Dad. Warmth and tenderness in the reaching. Soft close, like he's still imagining it as he speaks.
